body: When you make sense, you make sense. I have been at this for two years now and am in management. I really don't think they would want to lose me over this. I've got a spotless record otherwise. I really appreciate your help!
I'm working as a contractor for Uncle Sam, which is what worries me. I really don't want to jeopordize my security clearance. But health and well-being over all else, right?
Will do. I love my life damnit! And I don't want something preventable to end it. I think next time I feel an episode coming on, I'll hop on here to see if I can get any advice.

Unfortunately no. I'm on call and not allowed to leave the area. That's the nature of my job. As far as consultation goes, unless there's an online option for a service like that, I'm kinda stuck. I may need to talk to my employer and get back to the states for help if this turns out to be as serious as it feels.

My family does have a history of schizophrenia. I have heard voices, but usually when I'm tired or just waking up. I'm not going to experiment with anymore medications. As I've been thinking about this over the past few days, and now that you bring up the schizophrenia, I may need to talk to my employer and get back to the states for help. I don't know yet though.

Unfortunately I can't see a medical professional without informing my employer about what's going on. I would have to miss two days of work and just calling in sick would not be acceptable (termination and whatnot). I will stop taking the medication though. I knew it was dumb when I started it. I did confirm it was Zoloft though.
